title: Nvidia's Rubin expected to use mostly 12-layer HBM4 despite reported 8-layer shift
quote_evidence: Nvidia's next-generation Rubin AI accelerators are expected to rely predominantly on 12-layer HBM4 high-bandwidth memory, despite reports that the chipmaker has asked Samsung Electronics and SK hynix to increase supplies of 8-layer products...
why_it_matters_hint: Memory makers' product mix depends on which stack height Nvidia actually buys.
notes: Only the first sentence is visible (paywall); no other outlet found with the detail. Headline-only entry.
